mutations.name: held parses a copy of its schema instead of the ref its spec names
kills: each registered spec type parses with the slots schema its spec's ref names

mutations.name: held draws on the whole page instead of in the stage box
kills: hook and catalogue draw on the whole page and every spec kind past them in the stage box

kills: an inherited property name is not a beat kind

mutations.name: a reveal may land after its beat ends
kills: a reveal past its beat's end is rejected

mutations.name: a chapter may be numbered past its count
kills: a chapter numbered past its count is rejected
